name: Air Squats
instructions: Do 10–15 controlled squats, keeping chest up and weight in heels.

name: Eight Point Plank
instructions: Hold a plank with knees, toes, elbows, and hands touching the ground (8 points).

name: Foundation Training
instructions: Perform the Founder pose: hinge at hips, weight back, arms forward, hold for tension.

name: Push-ups
instructions: Do 10 push-ups. Keep body straight and core engaged. Modify on knees if needed.

name: Band Exercises
instructions: Perform band pull-aparts or rows to activate upper back and shoulders.
